body: Founder: 'give gunnrs e a stun.' Read 'e' as R, REDGARDEN's third/final cast slot. Added arena_apply_stun to the same target/range check Gunnr's R execute-scaled damage already uses. Duration copied from Zagan's own W stun (The Standstill, S170-230) as a named, independently-tunable constant -- this roster's second stun. HUD text + docs/HEROES_VS0.md updated. 2 new/expanded tests, full suite + test_10_bots.sh green. Commit 5d4ae44.
title: Gunnr's R now also stuns (backlog Sprint 1)
